children: Shift In Product Focus And Leadership

The group will sharpen its focus on advanced in-center dialysis and critical care technology, specifically promoting high-volume hemodiafiltration systems like the 5008S CAREsystem alongside the multiFiltratePRO.

Meanwhile, the firm will stop producing and selling its 4008A hemodialysis platform locally while completely exiting the peritoneal dialysis sector in China, though it will honor existing obligations.

These operational adjustments will result in one-time special charges of roughly 110 million euros (around $125.48 million) in the third quarter of 2026, primarily stemming from asset impairments, product scrappage, and contract termination expenses.
Executives anticipate no material effect from these portfolio changes on future revenue projections for the Care Enablement segment in China.
Fresenius Medical Care shares were up 1.21% to $22.62 at the time of publication on Friday, according to Benzinga Pro data.
